name: supabase
policyEngineNote: RLS is the last line of defense. Use it on the premise of defense in depth, together with application-layer checks. Moving this statement to an axis with no policy engine (aws-container and the like) turns it into exactly the opposite guidance — a value that must be passed on when generating the seam
symbolSurfaceNote: A pattern-knowledge pack — 0 top-level exports. The gate does not apply the reverse ledger check (find exports missing from the ledger) to this pack. See ledger.md for the full reasoning
fixesVariantsNote: No variant is nailed down. This pack is pattern-knowledge (0 exports) and the client, auth and policy are decided by the Supabase product — there is no in-axis branch the project can choose

thinPackNote: This pack is thin — 2 resources, 380 lines. A BaaS axis's backend guide is mostly about the host runtime (handlers, middleware, the error envelope, validation wiring), and the frontend axis decides that. Hence the 7 seamSlots — exactly the inverse ratio of a self-hosted server axis (aws-container: 5 pack resources, 1,191 lines · 3 seam slots).
